statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Wall Street futures are barely changed in holiday-thin trade while Gulf, oil and rate pressure keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold; sustained failed repair and repeated extension remain the escalation checkpoint.
headline: Nasdaq Tail stays WATCH as holiday futures remain muted
body: Asian technology shares are firm and Wall Street futures have barely moved, while Gulf escalation and Brent near $97 keep the environment stressed. Persistent one-way NQ mean-reversion failure is not verified.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding hourly assessments are available. Tail eased from 22-24% on September 6 to 20% early September 7 while Stress stayed extreme.
outlookSummary: WATCH is the baseline through Labor Day. Tail rises conditionally at the 22:00 UTC reopen only if a directional gap resists repair and repeated extension develops.
